stagingImplementation: lib/hiking/climate-validity.ts; comparison CLI available; public pipeline migration and real-data comparison pending
policyOrigin: Local conservative methodology decision, not an externally validated threshold or WMO certification
expectedHours: Enumerate canonical UTC hourly instants belonging to each IANA local date; hiking hours additionally pass the existing daylight-limited hiking-window predicate. Do not derive denominators from received records.

daily.partialPositiveEvents: Retain as diagnostic evidence only; exclude both positive and negative incomplete days from the probability denominator to avoid asymmetric ascertainment.

monthly.eventProbability: For each valid year-month, event days divided by fully observed event days; average valid yearly fractions equally.
monthly.continuousStatistics: Daily means use valid hours; yearly means use valid days equally; normal means use valid years equally. Quantiles and temperature utility use the same hierarchical weights over retained hourly samples.
monthly.windExceedanceProbability: Per valid year-month, exceedance hours divided by paired valid wind hours from accepted mean-coverage days; average yearly fractions equally. It is an observed-hour frequency, not a daily maximum or gust measure.
monthly.precipitationTotal: Average only complete local-calendar year-month totals; never scale partial totals to a full month.
monthly.snowDepthConditionalMean: Daily maximum physical snow depth on fully observed snow-event days, averaged within year then equally over valid years with snow days; zero only if all eligible years have zero snow days.
monthly.insufficientCoverage: Metric null, explicit coverage reason, no score/recommendation if any required scoring input is null; never renormalize score weights around a missing component.
monthly.boundaryPolicy: Apply the same criteria to partial local days at UTC download boundaries. Prefer retrieving adjacent UTC padding in a future ingest; exclude out-of-normal local dates, never shorten expected denominators.

migration: Implement and test in staging, regenerate aggregates from canonical hourly observations where available, compare old/new values and Golden cases, and review before activating. Existing monthly snapshots cannot recover missing-hour timing. No production approval is implied.
